label: copy-phase echo of r/y/s/k/l/n/d at mid-to-late steps
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (never on original tokens or <DEL>, and never at recall_idx 0 or almost never at recall_idx 1, i.e. not on the first fed-back token). Activation is driven by the fed-back input token: r (32% firing rate, ~31% of mass) and y (25%, ~19% of mass) are strongest, then s, k, l, n, d, with weaker i, 2, c; g and u rarely. Absolute position also modulates it: rates peak at t=11-12 (recall_idx 2-3) and in long sequences (L=9 holds ~half the mass); short sequences (L<=5) barely fire. The top activations are almost all an r or y input at recall_idx 2. Token identity plus position captures ~77% of mass, but many r/y/s/k... copy steps stay inactive, so precision is about 0.57.
